Description
Experience luxury living in this spacious 2 bed + 3 bath residence located in an iconic downtown landmark tower. Offering approximately 1,043 sqft of refined living space, this home showcases breathtaking unobstructed views of Stanley Park, Coal Harbour, the ocean, and the North Shore mountains. Designed by renowned architect Arthur Erickson, this landmark residence is situated in the heart of Downtown Vancouver and offers world-class, hotel-style amenities including a fitness centre, indoor pool, concierge service, luxury vehicle service, and acclaimed dining at Mott 32. Ideally positioned steps from luxury shopping, fine dining, and Vancouver’s vibrant waterfront lifestyle.
